☄️ Moid Addon v1.3
A powerful, highly optimized extension for Meteor Client on Minecraft 1.21+.

Welcome to the latest release of Moid Addon. This update focuses on heavy optimization, improved visuals (fades & gradients), and new bypasses for modern anti-cheats.

🆕 New Modules
🛡️ AntiResourcePack: Take back control. Automatically bypasses and blocks forced resource pack prompts from servers, preventing them from messing with your performance or visibility.

🎯 ProjectilePredictor: Predict the future. Visualizes the exact flight path of arrows, pearls, and potions, making it easier to land those cross-map shots.

🚀 Upgraded & Optimized
We've refactored the core of our most popular modules for better performance and "stealth" capabilities.

⚔️ Combat
Moid-KillAura: Massive logic overhaul. Improved target selection and optimized code for lower CPU usage during high-speed fights.

JumpMatrix: [MASSIVE UPGRADE] Complete rewrite. Added a new Merged Mode, more customization for movement, and heavy optimization for modern server checks.

🎨 Visuals & HUD
TargetHUD: Now features a high-fidelity Color Fade background. Includes a smooth health bar indicator, name list, and a real-time Inventory/Armor indicator for your target.

MoidTrails (Trails): Enhanced performance with new Chroma effects and rolling color fades. Your path has never looked this clean.

🧊 Utility & Movement
Fake-Lag: Added a Full Lag Mode specifically designed for bypassing advanced movement anti-cheats. Now includes rolling color fades to keep your HUD looking consistent.

# 🌙 Moid Addon - Version Update (v1.2)

### 🚀 **What’s New**

* **Triggerbot** – Added a brand new, highly responsive Triggerbot for that extra edge.
* **VulcaWeb (NoSlow)** – New movement module.
* *Note: For the best experience, we recommend using a maximum value of **0.650**.*



---

### ⬆️ **Upgrades & Improvements**

* **Moid FakeLag (MoidLag)** ⏳
* Massive stability overhaul. Now fully supports **Minecraft 1.21 all the way up to 1.21.11**. Fixed rendering crashes and added a fully customizable HUD.


* **Moid KillAura** ⚔️
* **MASSIVE UPDATE.** Completely rewritten to be a solid anti-cheat option. Features super-smooth aim and a wide range of new configurations.


* **Moid CircleESP** ⭕
* Heavy performance optimizations (FPS boost) and a ton of new customization options.


* **Moid Jump Matrix** 🌈
* Added a beautiful **Chroma (Rainbow) effect**.


* **Custom Mod Icon** 🎨
* We finally have our own custom identity!
* **MASSIVE SHOUTOUT** to **"TrissiFischi"** for the incredible design!



---

### 🗑️ **Removed / Deprecated**

* **Ping Spoof** – Removed (unstable/non-functional).
* **Trajectory** – Removed (non-functional).

---

### 🔧 **Internal Changes**

* Cleaned up dependency lines and optimized backend code for a smoother overall experience.
